ex.t: 非洲2400种；亚洲和太平洋或许3200种，其中仅巴布亚新几内亚就占了800多种。

ex.s: Today, on an island in the Pacific, a specific type of shell still serves as currency — and some people there are even hoarding it, just like Bitcoin moguls, convinced that one day, it will make them wealthy beyond imagination.
ex.t: 今天，在太平洋的一个岛屿上，一种特定的贝壳仍然作为货币使用——有些人甚至囤积它，就像比特币模具一样，相信有一天，它将使他们变得富有，超越想象。

ex.s: Using shells for money was common throughout the Pacific islands as late as the early 1900s, but Malaita is unique in that they are still used today.
ex.t: 早在1900年代初，整个太平洋岛国就普遍使用贝壳来换取金钱，但Malaita之所以独特，是因为贝壳今天仍在使用。
◆参观太平洋科学中心的商店

ex.s: Don’t forget to stop by Pacific Science Center’s Store while you are here to pick up a wonderful science activity or remember your visit.
ex.t: 在此期间，别忘了顺道去太平洋科学中心的商店，挑选一项精彩的科学活动或纪念品来纪念你的参观。

ex.s: The café is located upstairs in Building 1 and is open daily until one hour before Pacific Science Center closes.
ex.t: 咖啡厅位于1号楼楼上，每天开放至太平洋科学中心闭馆前一小时。

ex.s: Today Pacific Science Center serves more than 1.3 million people a year and beings inquiry-based science education to classrooms and community events all over Washington State.
ex.t: 今天，太平洋科学中心每年为130多万人提供服务，为华盛顿州各地的教室和社区活动提供以调查为基础的科学教育。

ex.s: Visit pacificsciencecenter.org to find various ways you can support Pacific Science Center.
ex.t: 访问 pacificsciencecenter.org 了解你能支持太平洋科学中心的各种方式。

ex.t: 你在太平洋科学中心哪里能买纪念品？

ex.t: 太平洋科学中心为学校做些什么？

ex.s: Match the routes to the explorers.] (1 Ferdinand Magellan (1480-1521) was a Portuguese explorer who sailed west from Spain across the Atlantic and Pacific oceans in search of a westward route to the Spice Islands (now part of Indonesia).

ex.s: Macquarie Island: from Chaos to Conservation I am standing on Macquarie Island, in the South-west Pacific Ocean, halfway between Australia and Antarctica.
ex.t: 麦夸里岛：从混乱到保护 我正站在麦夸里岛上，位于西南太平洋，在澳大利亚和南极洲之间的半路上。
